type_notes.narration_caption: A boxed narration line on a dark page; the narrator's commentary or a scene note. No rule content.
type_notes.system_notice: A short red-text notice in a black box with jagged corners; announces an event in one or two lines like a log line.
type_notes.hexagon_message: A polygon-outlined message with spiked tails; reads as voice from outside the scene, not a menu.
type_notes.system_window: A translucent coloured rectangle with short system text, usually a notification.
type_notes.info_card: A coloured window with a title and three or more key-value rows (a quest-card or stat-card shape).
type_notes.timer_window: A window whose text is digits, a countdown or clock shown over the scene.
type_notes.status_window: A stat or status sheet (names, levels, attributes).
type_notes.skill_card: A skill or ability card (name, level, cost or effect).
type_notes.other_window: A framed or coloured text window that fits no other type; check the crop.
